name: Halle’s Multiple Viewpoint Rendering
aliases: Epipolar Plane Image (EPI) based Multi-View Rendering
Epipolar Plane Image based Multi-View Rendering
Halle’s Multiple Viewpoint Rendering — Epipolar Plane Image (EPI) based Multi-View Rendering
definition: An algorithm that exploits the geometric structure of epipolar plane images (EPIs) to render scenes from several views simultaneously.
summary: Halle’s Multiple Viewpoint Rendering efficiently synthesizes novel views by extracting and stacking horizontal lines from epipolar plane images, avoiding full 3D volume traversal.
